staged_strict_studies.evidence_scope: Empirical tabular value learning on independent seeded synthetic grid/branch graphs. Schedules share identical experience and backup caps; actual backups may differ. The oracle solves only experienced transition counts, not unseen true geometry. Partial exposure is a shared shuffled history prefix, not an autonomous exploration policy. Goal relocation starts from identical warmed state; the planner should invalidate its old goal values. No neural weights are trained or promoted; these assays establish no biological equivalence or general navigation improvement. Timings are not included in deterministic evidence.
